name: Vendor-Neutral Workflow Spec Emission
description: Emit a workflow as a declarative, provider-mapped spec rather than as script bound to one runtime, so a blueprint can run on more than one vendor. The gate that makes this more than a translation exercise is a ROUND-TRIP: the emitted spec must reproduce the source's stage topology exactly, and a mismatch REJECTS the spec rather than patching it to look right. A stage with no mapping for a vendor is declared UNSUPPORTED for that vendor, never silently dropped.

source_workflow_path.description: The workflow to promote into a portable spec

provider_matrix.description: stage id -> vendor -> invocation. A missing cell means UNSUPPORTED, not 'the default'.

max_depth.description: The machine-readable form of the one-level-nesting rule. Fixed at 1 by design.

max_threads.description: REQUIRED WITH NO DEFAULT ON PURPOSE. The spec layer carries a live conflict: lifecycle.yaml says max_threads=4 while the owner's standing preference is to fan out large. Rather than silently inherit either value this blueprint refuses to run until the owner states one.

worker_model_floor.description: The second live conflict, also deliberately undefaulted: agent-roles/core.yaml routes worker=sonnet while the standing preference is Opus for all substantive subagents. The owner picks; the spec records the pick.

translator.description: Extracts the stage sequence, invariants and limits, and maps each stage per vendor

portability_critic.description: Lists what is genuinely vendor-locked instead of pretending it is portable

roundtrip_validator.description: Mechanically compares the emitted topology to the source topology

owner.description: Resolves the two recorded spec-layer conflicts; the spec cannot invent an answer

routes.reason: a portability critic from the locked-in vendor cannot see the lock-in

stages.title: S0 EXTRACT the stage sequence and invariants from the source workflow

work_unit.title: Extract topology and invariants from the source workflow
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the stage sequence, the dependency edges and the declared invariants of the source workflow, in document order.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: extraction fidelity is what the round-trip later measures

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the extracted topology is emitted as an ordered list of stage id, kind and dependency edges, so equality is decidable
tests_required: a workflow with a nested stage body must appear in the extracted topology, not be flattened away
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC05-S0 only when the topology list is ordered and includes every nested stage; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC05-S0 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to an AST-level extraction

stages.title: S1 MAP each stage to a provider invocation per vendor

work_unit.title: Map every stage to a per-vendor invocation, declaring UNSUPPORTED where there is none
work_unit.question_or_target: For each stage and each vendor, record the invocation, or record UNSUPPORTED explicitly rather than omitting the cell.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: an omitted cell reads as a default and is how portability is faked

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every (stage, vendor) cell is present and is either an invocation or the literal UNSUPPORTED
tests_required: a stage with no mapping for a vendor must yield UNSUPPORTED, never an absent cell
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC05-S1 only when the matrix is dense: every stage x vendor cell exists; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC05-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to declaring the vendor unsupported wholesale

stages.title: S1 gate: no stage is silently dropped for a vendor
S2 DECLARE limits and the typed handoff

work_unit.title: Declare limits and the typed handoff contract exactly
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the limits block and the handoff contract, carrying the required handoff fields exactly and pinning max_depth at 1.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the limits block is the machine-readable form of the nesting and handoff rules

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the handoff field set is compared element-by-element against the contract, not summarised as compatible
tests_required: a handoff missing one required field must FAIL rather than be reported compatible
max_depth other than 1 must FAIL - one-level nesting is not negotiable
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC05-S2 only when the handoff field set matches exactly and max_depth equals 1; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC05-S2 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry then escalate to the owner

stages.title: S2 gate: handoff fields exact, nesting depth pinned
S3 CRITIQUE portability - list what is vendor-locked

work_unit.title: Name every feature that is genuinely vendor-locked
work_unit.question_or_target: Identify each runtime feature with no cross-vendor equivalent and list it as vendor-locked rather than mapping it optimistically.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor, because the locked-in vendor cannot see its own lock-in

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each vendor-locked entry names the feature and the vendor that lacks an equivalent
tests_required: a Claude-only runtime feature must appear in vendor_locked_features, never be silently mapped
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the translator may contest an entry but may not delete it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC05-S3 only when every vendor-locked feature names both the feature and the lacking vendor; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC05-S3 <reason>

stages.title: S4 ROUND-TRIP validate: the spec must reproduce the source topology

work_unit.title: Compare emitted topology to source topology, element by element
work_unit.question_or_target: Assert that the emitted spec's ordered stage topology equals the source's, and emit the first differing element when it does not.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: topology equality is an exact comparison and must be computed, not judged

work_unit.evidence_requirement: records both topologies and the first differing element, so a pass is falsifiable
tests_required: dropping one stage from the emitted spec must make the round-trip FAIL
reordering two dependency edges must make the round-trip FAIL
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - this is an exact comparison, not an opinion
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC05-S4 only when both topologies are recorded and either equal, or the first difference is named; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC05-S4 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; a mismatch rejects the spec rather than retrying the comparison

stages.title: S4 gate: a round-trip mismatch REJECTS the spec
S5 OWNER resolves the two recorded spec-layer conflicts
stages.prompt: Two spec-layer conflicts must be resolved before this spec is authoritative: lifecycle max_threads=4 versus the standing fan-out-large preference, and roles.worker=sonnet versus the Opus-for-substantive-subagents preference. State which wins for each.

stages.title: S5 gate: both conflicting values are explicitly declared

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/spec/**; explicitly forbidden from writing platform/workflows/**, so it cannot overwrite the source it is translating

x_extensions.owner_decision: OPEN, and mechanised rather than assumed: max_threads and worker_model_floor are REQUIRED params with NO default, so this blueprint cannot run until the owner states which side of each live conflict wins. A default here would silently pick a winner.
x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: topology round-trip equality as a REJECT gate, plus explicit UNSUPPORTED cells. BP-XVD-04 is the runtime multi-rail dispatch; this is the spec format and the translation discipline that feeds it.
x_extensions.anti_overfit_anchor: this is declarative config over existing tools and explicitly NOT a second orchestration runtime - the dispatch shell invokes existing vendor CLIs.

worked_example.name: a dropped stage must fail the round-trip
worked_example.narrative: A three-stage source workflow with one nested body stage is extracted, emitted, and compared. Identical topology passes. Dropping the nested stage from the emitted spec must FAIL - that is the whole point of the gate, since a flattening translator otherwise looks successful. A stage with no provider cell must appear in vendor_locked_features rather than vanish.

controls.mutate: drop stage b-inner from the emitted copy
controls.why: a flattened nested stage is exactly the silent loss this gate exists to catch
